case.summary: Alert HHG-005 was triggered on card C02923-K1 by a legacy risk score of 0.54 on online transaction 3523199 for $100.07. The bank's calibrated second-generation fraud model scored this transaction at 0.005, reflecting an empirical historical fraud rate of 0.6%. Billing region 330 matches 85 of the card's 90 prior transactions, and device D000178 represents a generic iOS profile with no ring links or concurrent suspicious activity. With no customer dispute, velocity anomalies, or testing patterns, the alert is determined to be a false positive and closed as legitimate activity.
